messages:
Nina G: Quick question: do hardware partner referrals get a different SLA than marketplace leads? seeing a few sat calls waiting.
Omar K: we treated them the same historically but AtlasHW expects a faster turnaround for demo requests.
Sofia M: propose hw_referral_window=36h ack, 72h claim. marketplace keep 24/48.
Will R: we need a field 'referral_type' in intake to distinguish 'hw_referral' vs 'marketplace' vs 'si_direct'.
Nina G: good call. I'll update the form. Also adding 'demo_needed' boolean so ops can route demo-capable reps.
partner-ops-bot: Form updated: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partnerships/intake-forms (page 1002)  webhook success
Omar K: please add a flag 'requires_onprem_discussion' for private deploy asks so legal gets a heads up.
Sofia M: also log 'partner_rep_id' for downstream attribution.
Nina G: done. Thanks. We'll reconvene if volume stays high.
